title: Local Logistics Optimiser
challenge: Logix Regional was struggling with manual routing for its fleet, leading to inefficient paths and late deliveries to local businesses.
solution: We implemented a custom AI-driven routing algorithm using Python that calculates the most efficient routes based on real-time traffic and delivery priority.
outcome: Reduced fuel costs by 25% and improved delivery punctuality by 40% within the first three months of implementation.

title: Agile CI/CD Setup
challenge: StartupGo's single-developer backend was prone to manual errors during deployments, frequently causing downtime and regression bugs.
solution: We automated their entire build and deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions and AWS, including automated regression testing gates.
outcome: Increased deployment success rate to 99% and allowed the developer to push code shifts daily with confidence.

title: Business Reporting Hub
challenge: Alpha Retailer had sales data in Excel, customer data in a legacy CRM, and inventory info in a separate system, making it impossible to get a clear business overview.
solution: We built a centralized data hub using PostgreSQL and Metabase to unify these sources into a single, interactive dashboard for the management team.
outcome: Management now has a real-time view of inventory and sales, reducing stock-outs by 20% and improving promotional planning accuracy.

title: Small Office ERP System
challenge: Innovate Local was using physical files to track manufacturing orders, leading to lost data and slow communication between the office and the workshop.
solution: We developed a lightweight web-based ERP using Flask and React tailored to their specific workflow, replacing all physical paperwork.
outcome: Achieved 100% paperless operation, reducing communication lag by 80% and providing clear traceability for every order.

title: Law Firm Document AI
challenge: LexLaw's small team spent hours manually scanning through contracts for specific clauses, limiting the amount of work they could take on.
solution: We built a specialized RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system using an LLM to automatically extract and summarize key clauses from their legal documents.
outcome: Saved attorneys over 10 hours a week, allowing the firm to handle 1.5x more cases without adding staff.

title: Local B2B Marketplace
challenge: Local wholesalers struggled to reach retail shops efficiently, with most orders happening through fragmented phone calls and WhatsApp messages.
solution: We developed a custom web marketplace using Next.js that allows wholesalers to list inventory and retailers to place orders directly.
outcome: Onboarded over 50 local vendors within the first two months, automating over 80% of the daily ordering process.

title: Clinic Patient Management
challenge: National Clinic's local network had fragmented patient files across five different clinics, making it difficult for doctors to get a full patient history.
solution: We consolidated their patient records into a secure, centralized database with a simple interface for clinicians, ensuring 100% data accuracy.
outcome: Reduced administrative lookup time by 75% and improved patient coordination across the five clinic locations.

title: SwiftFit - AI Fitness App
challenge: A local fitness studio wanted an app that could use AI to help users maintain their form during home workouts and provide personalized workout plans.
solution: We developed a cross-platform mobile application using Flutter and integrated a custom TensorFlow Lite model for local, on-device form tracking.
outcome: Achieved over 10,000 downloads within the first month, resulting in a 20% increase in the studio's recurring revenue.

title: Lumina - Custom LMS
challenge: Lumina Academy needed a simple but effective e-learning platform to deliver niche courses for local professionals, as existing solutions were too complex.
solution: We built a focused Learning Management System using Next.js that emphasized ease of use and high-quality video delivery.
outcome: Achieved a 90% student satisfaction rate and enabled the academy to successfully transition to fully online delivery.

title: HapiHealth - Clinic Portal
challenge: Hapi Doctors faced critical front-desk bottlenecks with appointments happening manually via phone and paper ledgers.
solution: We developed a bilingual patient portal and booking system that integrates directly with their clinic's management software.
outcome: Reduced front-desk workload by over 50% and provided patients with an easy way to book and view appointments online.

title: Zenith CRM - Sales Automation
challenge: Zenith Local's two-person sales team was overwhelmed by manual lead tracking in spreadsheets, losing follow-ups regularly.
solution: We implemented a custom CRM with automated email follow-ups and a clear lead pipeline dashboard specifically for their small team.
outcome: Increased sales velocity by 20% and ensured zero leads were 'lost' due to lack of follow-up within the first quarter.

title: EcoTrack - Monitor
challenge: Green Monitoring needed a reliable way to collect and report emission data from scattered local industrial sites to ensure environmental compliance.
solution: We built a focused data ingestion platform using a cloud-native approach that collects and visualizes sensor data in near real-time.
outcome: Enabled monitoring across 50+ sites with 100% data reporting reliability, helping Green Monitoring secure new government contracts.

title: CricketPro Insights
challenge: Local cricket academies had no digital tool to track student progress, match performances, and video analysis of bowling/batting form.
solution: We developed a cross-platform app that allows coaches to track metrics, record video clips for analysis, and share progress reports with parents.
outcome: Onboarded 15 academies in the first month, digitizing progress for over 1,200 students and improving student retention by 15%.

title: QuickShop E-com
result: Onboarded 500+ items for a local store
challenge: A major local department store wanted to move online but found existing Shopify or Magento instances too expensive and over-engineered for their specific delivery model.
solution: We built a streamlined, light-weight mobile app using Flutter with a focused backend that allowed for rapid inventory updates and local delivery zone tracking.
outcome: Handled over 200 orders daily within the first month with zero technical failures, expanding the store's customer base by 25%.

title: CityRide Taxi App
challenge: A local taxi fleet was losing business to major ride-hailing apps because they didn't have an easy way for customers to book rides digitally.
solution: We developed a focused taxi booking app (Customer and Driver versions) featuring real-time GPS tracking and automated dispatching for the fleet manager.
outcome: Fully operational for a fleet of 100 taxis within four months, resulting in a 30% increase in bookings within the first quarter.

title: AutoAssist Telegram Bot
challenge: A small real estate boutique found themselves wasting hours weekly answering standard property questions on Telegram from potential buyers.
solution: We developed an intelligent Telegram bot that uses a focused knowledge base to answer property FAQs and schedule viewing appointments automatically.
outcome: The bot now handles over 80% of initial inquiries, freeing the agents for deep sales work and increasing viewing appointments by 25%.

title: ConnectWA WhatsApp Bot
result: Zero missed appointments in two months
challenge: A busy local clinic was struggling with patient no-shows because they didn't have an automated way to send reminders or allow easy cancellations.
solution: We built a specialized WhatsApp bot that sends automatic reminders, facilitates easy one-tap appointment rescheduling, and answers basic clinic info.
outcome: Reduced patient no-shows to near zero in the first two months, significantly improving the clinic's operational efficiency and patient satisfaction.
